changelog.title: Milestone 13: high-accuracy Polish STT foundation
items: Added preferred local large-v3-turbo CUDA int8_float16 transcription with truthful deterministic CPU fallback and no implicit model downloads.
Added bounded RAM-only VAD pre/post roll, generation-aware cancellation and transcript-free runtime diagnostics.
Added authenticated Polish Voice settings with a validated local vocabulary and conservative hotword hints.

Added low-confidence ToolEngine confirmation hardening and an opt-in gitignored WER/latency/RTF benchmark; target inspection correctly selected CPU fallback because Turbo and a required CUDA DLL are not installed.

changelog.title: Milestone 12: hardware-aware model routing
items: Added persistent Private, Fast, Quality, Deep and Auto modes with deterministic one-request Polish escalation.
Added local Qwen3.5 4B/9B Ollama tiers, configurable experimental 27B GGUF llama.cpp routing and bounded model residency.
Added explicit local-only/cloud-allowed policy with an optional fixed-origin OpenRouter text provider and strict context exclusions.
Added Protocol 1.4 route metadata and Polish AI settings; full target-hardware V1 release-gate validation remains pending.

changelog.title: Milestone 11: deterministic proactive watchers
items: Added bounded local watchers for windows, processes, files, resources, builds and downloads with explicit lifecycle APIs and confirmation-gated typed watcher tools.
Added SQLite schema v2 definitions and bounded structured event history with Protocol 1.3 notifications.
Added Polish overlay notifications and lightweight settings controls for pause, resume and deletion.
Kept watcher events notification-only: no autonomous routines, continuous vision or arbitrary shell execution.

changelog.title: Milestone 10: local memory and routines
items: Added versioned local SQLite persistence for explicit memories, preferences, aliases and opt-in completed conversation history.
Added deterministic bounded retrieval, secret-like value rejection and Polish settings controls for review, deletion and reset.
Added typed routine create/list/inspect/run/rename/delete APIs that reuse the existing permission and confirmation engine, plus confirmed create_routine proposals from explicit Polish requests.
Kept embeddings, automatic memory extraction, watchers and proactive behavior out of scope.

changelog.title: Milestone 9: system diagnostics
items: Added request-driven bounded CPU, RAM, disk, network and optional NVIDIA GPU telemetry.
Added deterministic process/GPU VRAM correlation, high-load facts, unavailable metrics and cancellable two-sample rates.
Kept telemetry memory-only with a twelve-snapshot/sixty-second history and routed diagnostic questions through verified measurements.

changelog.title: Milestone 8: selective local vision
items: Added bounded memory-only active-window and single-monitor region capture with stale-window and exclusion checks.
Extended the existing Ollama/Qwen conversation boundary with one ephemeral normalized image per request.
Completed inspect_screen metadata and a DPI-aware Tauri region selector with a removable reduced preview.
Kept visual text untrusted and all post-vision actions behind the typed permission and confirmation engine.

changelog.title: Milestone 7: structured Windows context
items: Added best-effort active-window metadata and bounded Windows UI Automation on a dedicated COM worker.
Added typed ephemeral snapshots with provenance, IDs, timestamps, timings, truncation and stale-window rejection.
Added password-field redaction, sensitive-app exclusions, privacy-safe logs and configurable hard limits.
Connected on-demand context tools to Qwen and added a restrained removable context indicator in the desktop overlay.
Kept screenshot capture and vision explicitly unavailable until Milestone 8.

changelog.title: Post-Milestone-6 security review
items: Bounded filesystem reads and listings at the I/O boundary and made file moves atomically refuse late destination collisions.
Canonicalized destructive targets before confirmation and bound approval availability to authenticated UI subscribers.
Prevented tool-launched processes from inheriting core credentials, resolved fixed apps through absolute Windows system paths, and pinned approved restart executables.
Made policy-write failures fail closed and tightened desktop/Rust correlation and response parsing.

changelog.title: Milestone 6: typed tools and permissions
items: Added the exact 18 planned typed tools with strict inputs, outputs, permission metadata, timeouts and deterministic implementations.
Connected Ollama structured tool calls to a bounded orchestrator that returns verified results before the final answer.
Added fail-closed local policy and operation-bound, expiring, single-use confirmation tickets for sensitive actions.
Added Protocol 1.3 tool events, a Polish confirmation card and a separate Tauri-held action credential.
Added path, process, application-launch and volume protections with security and property-based regression tests.

changelog.title: Milestone 5: local AI conversation
items: Added a replaceable loopback-only Ollama provider with Qwen3.5 4B and a Polish-only prompt.
Added bounded in-memory conversation context plus cancellable Protocol 1.2 response streaming.
Enabled authenticated typed chat and model lifecycle states in the desktop overlay.
Added rich display responses, concise voice replies and verified a real Polish model response on target hardware.

changelog.title: Milestone 4: custom wake-name onboarding
items: Added Polish name suitability scoring, generated confusable phrases and a guided desktop recording wizard.
Added deterministic local ONNX training, cancellable jobs, wake-only validation and sensitivity selection.
Added atomic model activation, previous-model preservation and safe cleanup for retraining.
Kept first-run microphone capture disabled until a validated wake model is active.

changelog.title: Milestone 3: Polish voice pipeline
items: Added bounded RAM-only microphone capture, temporary openWakeWord activation and Silero speech boundaries.
Added forced-Polish faster-whisper transcription, deterministic processing and cancellable Piper playback.
Added follow-up listening, stale-operation suppression and safe audio shutdown/retry behavior.
Protected voice traffic with a per-launch Tauri/core credential and Protocol 1.1 events.

changelog.title: Milestone 2 architecture review
items: Added bounded reconnect and heartbeat handling for late starts and core restarts.
Added correlated state snapshots and stale-session protection.
Hardened localhost, malformed-message and multi-client behavior.
Unified JSON Schema, Python and TypeScript validation with a shared contract corpus.

changelog.title: Milestone 2: local core and protocol
items: Added a localhost-only Python 3.12 FastAPI core with health and WebSocket handshake.
Added protocol-v1 contracts for health, assistant states and safe error handling.
Connected the desktop overlay to core health and graceful disconnected states.
Added deterministic state, protocol and provider-interface tests.

changelog.title: Milestone 1: desktop shell
items: Built the Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript desktop application.
Added a frameless always-on-top overlay with compact, chat and settings modes.
Added tray integration, a global fallback shortcut and simulated Polish assistant states.
Added frontend quality checks and state-transition tests.

changelog.title: Project foundation defined
items: Defined Polish-only local-first V1 architecture.
Added custom assistant-name and guided wake-word training design.
Selected initial Tauri/React + Python/FastAPI architecture.
Defined Qwen3.5 model tiers, Polish voice pipeline and screen-awareness strategy.
Added typed tool and permission model.
Created Codex-ready source-of-truth documentation structure.
Added development-status website and Pages workflow.
